scene_analysis.scene_overview: A city street with cars parked along both sides and a large building in the background. The street has a white line down the middle and there are trees lining the sidewalk. There are several cars parked along the street and a few people walking around. The sky is overcast.
scene_analysis.buildings: The building is tan colored with many windows and a flat roof. It has a decorative top edge and a small balcony on the second floor. The ground floor has a large window and a door.
scene_analysis.materials: The building's exterior is made of stone and has a smooth texture. The windows have metal frames.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are two benches on either side of the street.
scene_analysis.vegetation: There are four trees planted along the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.ground_surfaces: The ground is paved with asphalt.
